g.aria-label: Consolidate ebooks and course PDFs into a single application so that all reading material can be opened in one place.

g.aria-label: Reduce the number of steps needed to import course articles and PDFs from the school portal onto the iPad, without first downloading them to a computer.

g.aria-label: Provide an export action that sends course reading material directly to one chosen destination, such as Google Drive or a Kindle account.

g.aria-label: Save valuable course PDFs into a personal student library so that they remain accessible after the course or semester ends.
